root_cause.text: The RSI911x driver omitted setting `hw->vif_data_size` in its `ieee80211_hw` structure, causing mac80211 to allocate insufficient memory for the virtual interface (only `sizeof(struct ieee80211_vif)` without trailing driver data), yet the driver still writes its private `struct vif_priv` into `vif->drv_priv`, resulting in an out-of-bounds write and memory corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "The RSI911x driver does not set vif driver data size, no trailing space for vif driver data is therefore allocated past struct ieee80211_vif ... the driver does however use the vif driver data to store its vif driver data structure 'struct vif_priv'." The patch adds the line `hw->vif_data_size = sizeof(struct vif_priv);` to fix this.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing initialization of vif_data_size to enable per-interface private data for the RSI wireless driver.
intent_record.what: Added hw->vif_data_size = sizeof(struct vif_priv); in rsi_mac80211_attach function after setting extra_tx_headroom.
intent_record.how: This sets the size of private data per virtual interface in the ieee80211_hw structure, allowing mac80211 to allocate memory for per-interface driver data (struct vif_priv) when creating a new interface.
